_README: Independent measurements of these groups' Spotify totals at known points in
time. NOT the baseline: api/girlgroups.js keeps REFERENCE_YTD (the Sept 3
list) and is untouched by this file. This exists so that each new figure that
turns up gets checked against a growing pile of prior evidence instead of
archive  - kworb's own page, recovered from the Internet Archive. `label`
is kworb's 'Last updated' text; kworb's label runs ONE DAY AHEAD
of the streaming day, so `day` is the label minus one.
post     - a fan account publishing streams-by-year. `day` is the streaming
The two kinds agree, which is why both are kept: every archive capture
labelled 2025/12/31 came in ~one day of streams BELOW the post-derived
2025-12-31 close, for all three groups where both exist. That is the label
arithmetic confirming itself from an outside source.
Figures marked exact:false are rounded at the source. Do not subtract two
rounded figures and present the result as precise.

points.note: sum of 2022-2025: 420,327,111 + 2,990,491,226 + 2,254,491,519 + 1,480,362,154. The post's own five-year total of 7,830,749,319 reconciles exactly, so the parts are internally consistent.
3,437,987 below the 2025-12-31 close above — about one day at this group's rate.
sum of 2023-2025: 34,210,368 + 898,284,139 + 936,495,716. Reconciles exactly with the post's stated total of 1,971,703,191.
3,345,996 below the close above — about one day.

LAST reading before the drop. The track that left is BATTER UP [3VBj0lzjmhTzVFPEDOjNCG], worth 268,471,521 here, listed under no other id afterwards — so not a merge, and still live on Spotify (272,167,855 on 2026-09-06). The diff reconciles exactly: +103,043,613 growth on the 42 kept tracks, minus that track, is the -165,427,908 seen in the total. kworb's figures for this artist from 2026/09/04 onward therefore EXCLUDE a live track; ours do not.
The control. Against the Sept 4 total this yields a 2026 gain of 1,406,786,129 — identical to our own year-gained board, which tracked it live and independently all year.

Sum of annual figures 25M + 274M + 549M + 859M + 1.71B + 1.465B. Rounded at the source (the 2024 entry to 10M), so the error budget is about +/-7M — this CONFIRMS the archive reading above, it does not refine it. Agreement is 5,846,084 (0.12%). Kept because a fourth independent source costing nothing is worth more than the precision it lacks.

2024 790,983,034 + 2025 962,835,431. ILLIT debuted in March 2024, so those two years ARE the lifetime total — there is no earlier year to omit. No lifetime figure is stated to reconcile against, unlike the NewJeans and BABYMONSTER posts, but its own stated year-on-year delta of +171,852,397 checks out exactly, and the value falls correctly between the 2025-12-30 and 2026-01-03 archive captures below.

Brackets the post-derived close above. The implied 12-30 to 12-31 step is 6,827,256 against 3.71M/day over the following three days — a heavy New Year's Eve, not an inconsistency, and either way the close is now measured rather than interpolated from these two.
